definitions.gloss: buying and eating snacks on the go; eating while walking
definitions.explanation: The act of buying food at shops or stalls and eating it on the spot or while walking. Often associated with children buying snacks on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{買|か}い{食|ぐ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I bought snacks on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Buying snacks on the way was forbidden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{買|か}い{食|ぐ}いし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: It's fun to stroll through the shopping street, buying and eating snacks as you go.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally associated with school children buying snacks from shops on their way home. Many schools in Japan have rules prohibiting {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い. In modern usage, it also describes adults enjoying street food at festivals, markets, or shopping streets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition on buying snacks)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き→食べ歩き：15117_tabearuki⟧ / {買|か}い{食|ぐ}い (eating while walking / buying snacks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き→食べ歩き：15117_tabearuki⟧: eating while walking — focuses on the walking aspect, more positive connotation
- ⟦つまみ{食|ぐ}い→つまみ食い：27222_tsumamigui⟧: snacking, nibbling — picking at food before it's served
